prompt: A workflow says `runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, gpu]`. What does that label list mean?
explanation: A self-hosted job lands on a runner whose labels include every label in `runs-on` — `self-hosted` plus your own taxonomy. Label sets are how one fleet serves many teams without queues colliding, and the match is conjunctive.

options.text: Run the job three times, once per label
The job may run on any runner that has all of those labels
The job runs on a GitHub-hosted runner in the gpu region
The labels are documentation only; any runner may pick the job up
